content.description: Illustration showing hands using a feeler gauge to measure clearance between gears on a transmission shaft

content.text: 8. MEASURE FIRST AND SECOND GEAR THRUST CLEARANCE
Using a feeler gauge, measure the 1st and 2nd gear thrust clearance.

content.description: Illustration showing the use of SST (Special Service Tool) to remove counter gear center bearing outer race from intermediate plate

content.text: 9 INSTALL OUTPUT SHAFT TO INTERMEDIATE PLATE
(a) Before installing the output shaft, use SST to remove the counter gear center bearing outer race.
Install the outer race after installing the counter gear.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of output shaft into intermediate plate by pulling and tapping

content.text: (b) Install the output shaft into the intermediate plate by pulling on the output shaft and tapping on the intermediate plate.

content.description: Illustration showing input shaft and counter gear being installed together into transmission case

content.text: 10. INSTALL INPUT SHAFT AND COUNTER GEAR
(a) Install the input shaft and counter gear together.

content.description: Illustration showing the use of SST to install counter gear center bearing outer race

content.text: (b) Using SST, install the counter gear center bearing outer race.
Be careful not to damage the bearing rollers.
